coverageNotes: Measures ordered index declaration compatibility with a supplied typed equality/range query. No performance or arbitrary multi-index optimization claim.

questions.question: Which declaration lets this index-range query typecheck?

options.rationale: The supplied equality cannot skip sent_at to start on author_email.
The lookup index lacks sent_at after author_email; another index does not extend its range fields.
The supplied range cannot skip the leading content field.
The equality field is followed by the time field used by both range bounds.
